phase_summary: Push the flat Cheez-It box toward the storage region, then release and raise the hand.
contact_mode: Hand contact drives planar sliding, followed by release and retreat to a neutral raised-hand interval.
constraints_strategy: Use planar support friction while approaching the constrained area near the obstacle and rail.

phase_summary: Drop the hand to a new contact face and push the box around the obstacle into storage.
contact_mode: The descending recontact transitions into single-face pushing while the box stays flat and slides.
constraints_strategy: Choose a new face with lateral authority because the obstacle blocks the straight path, then use the available corridor.

phase_summary: Push the flat box until it contacts the wall rail.
contact_mode: Face contact from the hand; planar sliding on the table.
constraints_strategy: The box is too flat to grasp directly, so the wall rail becomes an external fixture.

phase_summary: Flip the box upright against the wall rail, then settle it in a graspable pose.
contact_mode: Contact changes from sliding to wall-table pivoting and then light stabilization of the upright box.
constraints_strategy: The wall arrests translation to create the flip pivot; stabilization preserves balance and edge exposure.

phase_summary: Grasp the exposed edge and lift the box.
contact_mode: Opposing grasp contact replaces environmental support.
constraints_strategy: The upright pose provides clearance for fingers around the box edge.

phase_summary: Pull the box out from between the two obstacles.
contact_mode: Pulling contact on an exposed face or edge; the box slides out of the gap.
constraints_strategy: The obstacles constrain lateral motion, so extraction follows the open direction.

phase_summary: Reposition the flat box and push it toward the wall rail.
contact_mode: Hand-face pushing contact with planar sliding.
constraints_strategy: After extraction, move through free space to the fixture needed for flipping.

phase_summary: Use the wall rail to flip the box upright and expose an edge.
contact_mode: Contact changes from sliding to wall-table-assisted pivoting.
constraints_strategy: The wall arrests translation and supplies the moment arm for rotation.

phase_summary: Grasp the exposed upright edge and lift the box.
contact_mode: Opposing grasp contact replaces hand and environmental support.
constraints_strategy: The upright geometry creates finger clearance absent in the initial flat pose.

phase_summary: Push the flat box into contact with the wall rail.
contact_mode: Face pushing contact; the box slides flat on the table.
constraints_strategy: The wall rail is used as the fixture for the later flip.

phase_summary: Flip the box upright using the wall rail as a pivot.
contact_mode: Contact switches from sliding to edge and face pivoting against wall and table.
constraints_strategy: The wall blocks translation and converts the push into rotation.

phase_summary: Pull the upright box away from the wall for gripper insertion.
contact_mode: Pulling contact on the upper or side region; the box slides or rocks upright.
constraints_strategy: Expose a graspable edge by pulling the object.

phase_summary: Insert around the exposed edge, grasp, and lift.
contact_mode: Opposing grasp contact takes over from environmental support.
constraints_strategy: The clearance pull leaves enough free space for a stable edge grasp.

phase_summary: Push the box toward the wall rail and slot entrance.
contact_mode: Hand-face pushing contact with planar sliding.
constraints_strategy: The obstacle and wall define the storage opening; first bring the box to this constrained region.

phase_summary: Flip the box upright and align its narrow face with the opening.
contact_mode: Contact changes from sliding to pivoting against the wall-table constraint.
constraints_strategy: Rotate into an upright orientation compatible with the narrow opening.

phase_summary: Pull the upright box into the storage opening.
contact_mode: Pulling contact on the upright box as it slides between fixtures.
constraints_strategy: The wall and obstacle guide the final motion and constrain lateral error.

phase_summary: Rotate and reposition the flat box to align it with the narrow storage gap.
contact_mode: Contact shifts across corners and faces while the box pivots and slides.
constraints_strategy: The opening is narrow, so the box must reach an insertion-compatible orientation first.

phase_summary: Recontact the side and push the box into alignment with the opening.
contact_mode: Side-face pushing contact translates the box across the tabletop.
constraints_strategy: The fixtures define the slot and require lateral positioning before insertion.

phase_summary: Recontact the rear edge and push the box into the storage slot.
contact_mode: Rear-edge pushing drives planar sliding while fixtures provide lateral guidance.
constraints_strategy: The constrained corridor guides the box into its final stored pose.

phase_summary: Press the tightly placed box to topple it outward and expose an edge.
contact_mode: Palm and finger pressure on the box face; the box pivots while neighbors support it.
constraints_strategy: The surrounding objects prevent direct grasping, so the constrained press creates finger clearance.

phase_summary: Grasp the exposed edge and pull the box free.
contact_mode: Finger-and-thumb grasp on the protruding box replaces pressing contact.
constraints_strategy: The toppled pose provides clearance for a stable edge grasp.

phase_summary: Slide the flat book toward the table edge until one side overhangs.
contact_mode: Palm contact pushes the book while it slides on the tabletop.
constraints_strategy: The table edge removes support beneath one side and creates finger clearance.

phase_summary: Grasp the overhanging edge and lift the book.
contact_mode: Finger-and-thumb grasp replaces planar pushing contact.
constraints_strategy: The overhang permits fingers to wrap around an otherwise ungraspable flat edge.
